title: Pork fillet pizzaiola
summary: Pork fillet pizzaiola is a italian dinner built around pork fillet and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat pork fillet dry and season it. Prep chopped tomatoes and garlic for Pork fillet pizzaiola so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook pork fillet on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook chopped tomatoes and garlic in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Pork fillet pizzaiola before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
